title: When Silence Sings
description:
What happens when the dream you've always wanted becomes the very thing that threatens to destroy you?

After years abroad, Tife returns home with a beautiful voice, a burning passion for music and a determination to pursue her dreams. But her father, a respected pastor haunted by the tragedies of his past, has an entirely different future planned for her.

When an influential music executive offers her the opportunity of a lifetime, Tife finds herself navigating a world of ambition, manipulation, unspoken love and difficult choices. As the lines between freedom and captivity begin to blur, she must discover what it truly means to find her voice without losing herself.

WHEN SILENCE SINGS is an emotional Christian drama that explores faith, love, grief, parental expectations, the price of fame and the redemptive power of truth.

Sometimes, the loudest cries are the ones nobody hears.

A story that will challenge your perspective, stir your emotions and remind you that silence is not always surrender.

Presented by Love Story Media and Bammy Bestowed TV.

Please LIKE, COMMENT, SHARE and SUBSCRIBE to support meaningful storytelling.

We would love to hear from you: At what point does protection become control?

title: Don's Back: No One Touches His Daughter
description:
Eighteen years ago, Leonardo Gambino ruled New York's underworld. At eighteen, he took control. By thirty-three, he survived a brutal war that buried half his brothers. That night, he learned his wife was pregnant—and for the first time, he had something greater than power: a family.So he walked away. He divided his fortune, abandoned his legend, and vanished with his wife and closest friend. Under a new name, he opened a small bar in a quiet town and built an ordinary life.Eighteen years later, no one recognizes the former Godfather in the gentle bartender. To his seventeen-year-old daughter Sofia, he is just Dad—a harmless man shielding her from his dark past.Then Sofia becomes the target of vicious bullies. Threatened and terrified, she lies to protect the father she believes is only a bartender. She has no idea what he used to be.
Until Leonardo sees what they have done to her.Black cars arrive in the rain. Armed men emerge from shadows. Old soldiers bow before their Godfather. Luca stands at his side. And in the darkness, Dominic Gallo—believed dead—still lives.The Colombos think they have inherited his city. They are wrong. When the Gambino crest appears, Jack's arrogance crumbles. When hundreds answer one call, Jacob—once Leonardo's driver—realizes the truth: Leonardo did not disappear because he lost. He chose family over power.
Now someone has hurt his daughter.Sofia watches in disbelief as her gentle father transforms. The bartender is gone. In his place stands the man who once made New York kneel—the Godfather whose name still commands fear and loyalty.Old enemies gather. Former allies return. The Colombos come for blood. Leonardo must decide how far he will go to protect the family he sacrificed everything to build.
They have no idea they are touching the daughter of the Godfather.And when the man who made a city bow finally stops hiding—who will be left standing when his old name is spoken again?

title: Numberblocks Season 1 - Full Episodes
description: A little block falls out of the sky, meets her numberling and discovers one wonderful world, singing and counting to one. Learn all about the number 1 with Numberblock One! --- For more, download the official Numberblocks apps; Meet the Numberblocks - Numberblocks Card Fun - Numberblocks World - Numberblocks Hide and Seek - NB Bedtime Stories - Official website; As seen on CBeebies! Watch Numberblocks full episodes on BBC iPlayer: Subscribe for more Numberblocks: Visit the Numberblocks on; Twitter: @numberblocks Facebook: facebook.com/numberblocks/ Instagram: @numberblocks We are the Numberblocks! Little blocks with big ideas, having a ton of number fun. Learn how to add, subtract and count the fun and educational way! In this educational CBeebies cartoon for kids, children can learn how to count with basic maths sums, using addition and subtraction with singular blocks that join together to make increasingly bigger numbers. #Numberblocks #FullEpisode #Season1 #LearnToCount

title: Business English: Finance and Economics
description: Do you work in finance or interact with finance professionals? Is it necessary to speak, write or understand English in your career? Follow the authentic characters in this course as they work through common business situations in finance and economics. Learn from your successes and failure, and think critically about your own communication options. After taking this course, you will be able to read and create efficient e-mails, reports, and impactful presentations with words and phrases commonly used in finance and economics. Communicate clearly under pressure utilizing recently learned strategies, and obtain immediate feedback about the efficiency of your business communication skills in English from other finance professionals around the world! Gain the English communication skills that you desire and that global managers expect.

title: Business English: Networking
description:
This course begins with a welcome message and an overview of the Specialization. After this introduction, you will be asked to take a proficiency test to see if this course is right for you. 
During the course, you will begin learning vocabulary and customs related to socializing and networking in English. The goal is to enable you to interact with business contacts in person, on the phone and over email in a professional way.
Course Learning Objectives
•	Determine whether the objectives of this Specialization align with your learning goals
•	Evaluate your current level of proficiency in business English communication 
•	Present relevant information about yourself in a discussion forum
•	Develop your networking skills 
•	Write short emails with appropriate formatting
•	Recognize and produce formal and informal language in emails
•	Develop vocabulary related to jobs and companies

title: Business Entrepreneurship
description:
In 17 episodes, Anna Akana will teach you entrepreneurship skills to help you start and run a small business. This course is based on a college-level curriculum with a variety of reference texts, including the Strategyzer Business Model Canvas. By the end of the course, you will be able to:

* Evaluate the quality of an idea and take steps to turn it into a small business
* Understand the legal basics of business entity formation, sales, costs, and other finances
* Develop a clear value proposition for your business and customer relationships
* Navigate other businesses, including both competition and key partners 
* Define success for yourself as an entrepreneur, and recognize failure

title: Arabic for Beginners: Communicating in Arabic Culture
description:
This course is the second of a three-course specialization in elementary Arabic. Communicating in Arabic Culture begins with specifically delving into terms related to education and school-related terminology. Speaking Arabic as a second language in a culturally and internationally diverse workspace can offer significant rewards. 
Furthermore, proficiency in Arabic becomes exceptionally valuable when traveling to or working in Arabic-speaking countries, particularly in situations involving financial transactions. In our technology-driven world, where technology impacts nearly every facet of life, from transportation efficiency and safety to access to food, healthcare, socialization, and productivity, the internet's power has facilitated the formation of global communities for the easy sharing of ideas and resources, as exemplified by this course. Understanding the human body's various parts in the context of international sports and medicine is of paramount importance. This course, therefore, focuses on the multifaceted uses of body parts, both physical and emotional, as forms of expression in Arabic culture.

title: Excel Skills for Business: Intermediate I
description:
Spreadsheet software remains one of the most ubiquitous pieces of software used in workplaces across the world. Learning to confidently operate this software means adding a highly valuable asset to your employability portfolio. In the United States alone, millions of job advertisements requiring Excel skills are posted every day. Research by Burning Glass Technologies and Capital One shows that digitals skills lead to higher income and better employment opportunities at a time when digital skills job are growing much faster than non-digital jobs.
In this second course of our Excel specialization Excel Skills for Business you will build on the strong foundations of the Essentials course. Intermediate Skills I will expand your Excel knowledge to new horizons. You are going to discover a whole range of skills and techniques that will become a standard component of your everyday use of Excel. In this course, you will build a solid layer of more advanced skills so you can manage large datasets and create meaningful reports. These key techniques and tools will allow you to add a sophisticated layer of automation and efficiency to your everyday tasks in Excel.
Once again, we have brought together a great teaching team that will be with you every step of the way. Prashan and Nicky will guide you through each week (and I am even going to make a guest appearance in Week 5 to help you learn about my favourite tool in Excel - shh, no spoilers!). Work through each new challenge step-by-step and in no time you will surprise yourself by how far you have come. This time around, we are going to follow Uma's trials and tribulations as she is trying to find her feet in a new position in the fictitious company PushPin. For those of you who have done the Essentials course, you will already be familiar with the company. Working through her challenges which are all too common ones that we encounter everyday, will help you to more easily relate to the skills and techniques learned in each week and apply them to familiar and new contexts.

title: Mbosso - DJ  (Official Music Video)
description:
'DJ' is the fuse of Afrobeats rhythms with modern three step grooves, delivering an emotional yet dance ready sound. Where as the track explores the narrative of a restless heart and a troubled mind, capturing the inner conflict of someone burdened by thoughts, pain, and emotional pressure.

Through poignant lyrics and street wise metaphors, Mbosso expresses exhaustion from tears and unspoken feelings. Amidst this emotional storm, the DJ emerges as a symbol of escape and healing, the one capable of transforming pain into rhythm and silence into sound. The recurring refrain, “Mr. DJ, turn it up,” reflects a desperate desire to drown sorrow in music and find temporary peace on the dancefloor.

title: From Unwanted Daughter to Mafia Princess
description: Abandoned by her father on a rainy Thanksgiving night, six-year-old Angie saves New York’s most powerful mafia boss with a muddy sweet roll. In gratitude, Vincent adopts her and raises her as his beloved princess. But when her greedy birth family returns and enemies plot to kill, Angie risks her life to protect her new family. With Vincent at her side, the little girl once left in the mud becomes the cherished heir to a mafia empire.

title: Borrowed Glances
description: Cold-hearted CEO Karen of Hayes Group is trapped in brutal internal family power struggles. Convinced that the gentle Shana is a pawn planted by her stepfather Leon, she spends one turbulent night with Shana out of suspicion and caution, leaving money afterwards to treat their encounter as a transaction. Shana refuses to take a single cent. Born into a reclusive wealthy family, she has had a crush on Karen since her youth and approaches her purely out of long-held secret love. Plagued by doubt, Karen keeps testing Shana, yet against her better judgment, she keeps making exceptions and falling for her.Leon and his daughter scheme relentlessly to seize corporate power and close in on Karen step by step. After layers of misunderstandings are finally cleared up, Karen realizes Shana's selfless true affection. She dismantles her stepfather's power-grabbing plot, lets down her defenses, and embraces this years-long secret crush. The two find mutual love and stay together.

title: Married My Sister's Groom and Make Him Regret

title: My Mech Broke, I Became the Weapon
description: Thirty years ago, the Abyss Rifts opened and mechanical abominations invaded Earth. Humanity fought back against the alien menace using mechs. Cole Astra was written off by the Astra family as a castoff outcast due to his mere 40-percent mech neuralsync rate, enduring constant contempt and suppression from his father, brother and sister.On the brink of death, the fragment of an advanced civilization inherited from his mother awakened within him. Cole gained the defying-heaven ability to absorb mech power directly into his own flesh. He steam-rolled all powerful rivals in the Resource Trials. After claiming the championship, he publicly severed ties with his cold-blooded family.Then three demigod-class abominations launched a full-scale invasion, bringing catastrophe to the city. Left stranded in a death trap with his mech destroyed, Cole pushed past his limits once more. Mastering the power of the Storm Sovereign, he slew the demigod foe with a sky-piercing tornado and saved the entire city. Bidding farewell to his mother, he turned into a shooting star and headed for far-off battlefields. His grand odyssey had only just begun.

title: Rejected by Three Alphas, Claimed by the Lycan King
description:
She reached out for help — and all three of her Alphas swam right past her, straight to another woman.
Riley, eighteen, was once the girl three powerful Alphas fought over — her fiancé Chase, her childhood friend Mark, her stepbrother Ethan. Everyone assumed she'd choose one of them as her fated mate. Then a sweet-faced Omega named Chloe appeared, and everything changed. They shattered their blood bond with her, chained her in a dungeon as a living ""blood bag,"" and drained her veins with a syringe — all to heal Chloe's face. To everyone, she was nothing but a ""wolf-less freak.""
Until the Blood Moon rose. The Moon Spirit, asleep for ten thousand years, awakened inside her — revealing that Riley was the true Lycan Queen, the one who reigns above every Alpha. On the night her silver hair blazed to life, the whole hall knelt at her feet. She left them just one line: ""None of you. I choose no one.""
She turned away, took the Blood Moon Crown, and married the empire's most powerful ruler — Alex Reed, the cursed Lycan King who'd worn a silver muzzle for ten years, a beast who'd endure a thousand needles through his heart before ever hurting her. She purged his Godslayer curse with her sacred blood; he burned her enemies to ash with royal flame. When the three men who betrayed her crawled back begging, when the truth of the Omega's every crime came to light — their Blood Moon wedding became her most breathtaking reckoning.
From a discarded girl trampled into the mud, to a goddess ruling the world beside her King. This time, they kneel and look up at her.

title: A Lifetime Too Late (DUBBED)
description: It is only after Heidi Jaffe's death after donating her heart to Chad Shelby's first crush does Chad realize he had already fallen for her a long time ago. Overwhelmed with guilt, he chooses to end his own life—only to unexpectedly transmigrate into the system and enter Heidi’s world. Determined to make amends and win her back, he tries everything to regain her love, yet uncovers a cruel truth regarding what he thought was Heidi's unconditional love for him.

title: Miss You After Goodbye
description: To repay a debt of kindness, Neil signs a secret contract with Keira's father stating that he will marry Keira for five years and help her recover from a painful breakup with her first love, Simon. During their contract marriage, Neil is attentive and caring towards Keira, but she never treats him as anything more than Simon's substitute. When the contract comes to an end, Neil discovers Keira's persistent infatuation with Simon and finally decides to divorce her.

title: When a Man's a Man
description: Helen Wakefield refuses the marriage proposal of Lawrence Knight, a rich lounge lizard, and advises him to improve himself by developing manly traits. He travels out west, changes his name to "Patches," and gets together some cattle rustlers. He is accused of being an outlaw and of shooting a fellow cowpuncher, falls in love with a ranch girl, leaves her, and then accidentally meets Helen Wakefield in a pasture where he is trying to rope a ferocious bull and she is drawing water. As the bull attacks Helen, Knight lassos it in time to save her; and they recognize each other. During his absence Helen has married and come to the West accompanied by her surveyor husband. Knight's old love flashes up, but having recently developed manly traits, he sets his jaw and departs for another section of the country.

title: A Tale of a Day & a Night
description: The narrative is of Suzan, a Christian nun reminiscing over two deaths; one that filled her heart with light and another that darkened her soul forever.

title: A Journey to a Journey
description: After a brilliant university student is rejected from a prestigious research program, his subsequent investigation uncovers the shocking truth about the nameless, timeless society in which he lives.

title: A Prince in a Pawnshop
description: David Solomon, a wealthy banker, is merciless in his dealings with his rich clients, from whom he exacts the highest interest. He aids the poor as much as possible. To facilitate his kindness among the people of the Ghetto, he runs there a pawnshop, unlike all others, for to the needy he measures out money, not according to the value of the articles they offer, but according to their needs. David's son, Maurice, is given to high living. It grieves his father, who is, however, consoled by the fact that his daughter, Ethel, seconds her father's charities by maintaining a day nursery for the children of the poor. One day David sees a young girl fall unconscious in the street. He takes her to the hospital where the doctor tells him that the girl, Mary, is suffering from exhaustion. David's heart is touched and he resolves to make Mary's future his own care. When she has regained her strength he finds her a position as a model in a dress house of a friend, Silver. Ethel visits the dress house to buy gowns, bringing Maurice with her. He sees Mary for the second time, having noticed her upon the street. Maurice arranges to meet Mary under an assumed name, and pursues his courtship with all seeming love. She so learns to worship Maurice that she gives him all, not stopping to count the cost, nor to demand the wedding ring. For a brief while Mary tastes of a great happiness, but Stevins, the man for whom she once worked, and who, because she would not encourage his advances, drove her from every honest position, naming her as a thief, visits the dress house to get gowns for "The Bunch of Flowers," a set of girls so termed by Maurice who has been much in their company. He recognizes Mary, repeats the accusation, and her employer discharges her. Mary returns to the little flat supported by Maurice, where she tells her story. Maurice has begun to tire of her. He seeks Stevins, who tells a seemingly truthful story. Maurice believes it and leaves Mary, writing to this effect. He, however, does not know that the girl he has wronged is about to become a mother. Six years elapse, and we find Mary and her little son, living in poverty. Again she is rescued by David Soloman, who has called to see a deserving case next door to Mary, the object of his charity being Mrs. Payne, the landlady who drove Mary from her door, and who is now a paralytic. title: Give a girl a fish
description: Unlike Vegas, what happens on social media doesn't always stay on social media. This documentary follows the real day-to-day activities of 5 women that use social media and dating apps for unlimited attention, free meals, travels and gifts, to become online celebrities, modeling, and to promote adult entertainment and sex work.

title: A Ghost of a Chance
description: When a not-so-stellar lawyer is in need of something to help her case she has to rely on an unconventional witness for testimony. Will the court agree to hear testimony from and will the witness appear in the first place? After all, we are talking about a samurai ghost.

title: A Woman Is a Woman
description: The film follows two trans women in Hong Kong - Chiu Ling Fung is still at school but has been wrestling with their gender identity. Meanwhile Sung Chi Yu has been happily married for ten years, but has kept a secret from her family.

title: A Date with a Duchess
description: A variety extra falls in love with a beautiful duchess, and tries to impress her by posing as a rajah. He tells her the truth before anything happens, and leaves.

title: A Dollar and a Grave
description: An American drifter becomes involved in a deadly family dispute. A powerful Mexican rancher orders the killing of his daughter's boyfriend. Jones earns the wrath of the father when he finds the body and buries it.

title: A Video a Day
description: I wanted to create a 'Ghost' Series that saying hidden from most peoples eyes and has more of a Feel side of it, This 'Ghost' series is made of Single one of Episodes and some random series that has been uploaded to my personal channel, Kenneth Cox.

title: A Hole in a Fence
description: Chronicling the changing fortunes of a unique abandoned lot in Red Hook, Brooklyn, A Hole in a Fence explores the complicated issues of development, class and identity facing the city's most populous borough.

title: A Prince of a King
description: In a fifteenth-century kingdom, Duke Roberto usurps the throne by poisoning King Lorenzo and abandoning the sole heir, Prince Gigi, in the wilderness. A troupe of Gypsy acrobats discover the infant prince, and their leader, Andrea, adopts him. Gigi becomes the troupe's star performer, but during a visit to the kingdom, he attempts to escape the abusive acrobats. The prince is recognized by the court physician and returned to the queen mother. Duke Roberto is punished for his crimes and the Gypsies are banished from the court.

title: A Whale of a Tale
description: The discovery of a whale vertebrae in Toronto's harbor leads to an investigation as to how the bone got there. Along the way we meet an interesting cast of characters and explore the meaning of life.

title: A Guy and a Gal
description: Hypochondriac Lasse can and does pull the girls with no trouble, although for a short while this causes a real and painful health problem. Meeting Lena while delivering papers - the nearest he has got to his favoured career of journalism - he finds himself getting serious. But he seems unable, or unwilling, to give up the girls, his phobia, and work-shy lifestyle. Something will have to give.

title: Mare Nostrum: A Concert, a Journey
description: A journey to the sounds and also to the silence, to other cultures, as far as Africa and then back across the sea, to the unfamiliar and to friends - and then finally, to ourselves.

title: A Noiva Que Ouviu a Morte
description: Na noite do casamento por substituição, Nina Soares é empurrada para dentro da poderosa família Monteiro como moeda de troca. Todos acham que ela é só uma garota lenta, quebrada e fácil de sacrificar. Ninguém sabe que ela nasceu com um dom impossível: ouvir os animais. Na mansão de Dante Monteiro, herdeiro sombrio cercado por homens armados, segredos, venenos e inimigos de sangue, Nina usa sua habilidade para salvar a vida dele e virar o jogo. Entre humilhações, vingança e poder, ela deixa de ser a noiva descartável e se torna a única mulher capaz de ficar ao lado do homem mais temido da cidade.

description: Get ready for an all-new spiritual exploration through film. title: A Luna Rejeitada É a Alfa
description: O mundo de Alana se estrompa após perder sua alcateia e seu parceiro. Um ano depois, ela exige um divórcio de Victor quando ele traz sua amante, General Selene, para se apoderar da alcateia de Alana. Com a ajuda do Rei Alfa Carlos, Alana luta de volta. Enquanto o casamento de Victor e da Selene implode, Alana expõe sua cumplicidade com vampiros. Após uma feroz batalha, Alana recupera sua honra, restaura seu legado e encontra novamente o amor.

title: A Boy, a Girl and a Dog
description: During World War II, a young boy and girl, living with their respective families in an apartment house that had restrictions against pets, adopt a lost dog and hide it in a vacant apartment, which may have been the only vacant apartment in the United States at the time this movie was being filmed. A burglar breaks in and the apartment is damaged when the dog and crook have a tussle. This blows the dog's cover, but the kids enlist him in the K-9 Corps, and the dog distinguishes himself in the WWII Italian campaign.

title: A Miracle
description: A distinguished surgical unit turns upside down when a strange new resident joins the team. Ali has Savant syndrome, making it hard for him to communicate with other people, even though he is a phenomenal doctor.

title: A Fool and a Lover
description: The story of a young lady desperate to be in a marriageable relationship who wakes up to an engagement ring and presumes it's hers, only to discover it was for her lover's ex.

title: A Guy, a Gal and a Pal
description: A young woman devises a clever scheme to secure a train reservation by pretending to be married to a stranger.

title: A Squirrel and a Hedgehog
description: Two teenagers (Geumsaegi and Juldarami) fight against an evil army.

title: A Rose with a Gun
description: Mara, who grew up without the warmth of a loving family, unexpectedly becomes a stepmother to two wounded children after marrying into the Bellacosta family. Facing betrayal, secrets, and danger, she chooses courage over escape, protecting the children and rebuilding trust at home. As hidden truths resurface, the family stands together, learning that love, responsibility, and courage can lead them toward a new beginning.

title: A Year in a Village
description: The documentary A Year in a Village features a village in Moravia, Czech Republic. The focus is on 12-year-old Vojta and his father Danek, who are both into beekeeping and on Vojta's 16-year-old cousin Anetka, who is preparing for her first participation in "hody" celebration, and of their grandmother Bohuska. We watch the members of the family work and perform their hobbies. We listen to their opinions, trying to understand their thinking, as well as the world they live in. Even though a part of the documentary features the traditional feast called "hody", the aim is not to describe the event itself, but to understand how the characters feel about being a part of it and how it influences them.

title: Point B
description: Four friends and Graduate students in the physics department of their University discover their clean energy machine actually works as a crude, rudimentary teleportation device. Through experimentation, adjustments and some misuse-use of the device, it is quickly discovered that the machine holds many consequences.

title: Plan B
description: Et si c'était possible de faire marche arrière dans le temps pour modifier le cours des événements et changer sa destinée? Et si une deuxième chance nous était offerte? Et si c'était possible grâce à Plan B - Le jour où Philippe perd l'amour de sa vie, Evelyne, il découvre une invraisemblable compagnie du nom de Plan B qui offre la possibilité de revenir dans le passé. Après un premier essai fructueux, Philippe réalise l'immense pouvoir que lui donne ce stratagème. Il voudra donc aussi s'en servir au profit de son cabinet d'avocats qu'il possède avec son associé/ami/beau-frère Patrice et pour remettre son frère André sur le droit chemin. Mais Philippe réalisera qu'un choix nouveau, aussi minime soit-il, a des répercussions aussi incontrôlables qu'insoupçonnées sur sa vie et celle des autres. Plus rien ne sera sans conséquence. Le jeu en vaut-il la chandelle? Valait-il mieux accepter son véritable destin?

title: Tamon's B-Side [English]

description: Burlesque beauties performing their signature striptease acts, accompanied by comedians, testing the moral boundaries.

title: Ivelisse vs Izzy B
description: Kelsey Raegan wears the stripes and you can tell from the introductions that she may not be impartial here. Ivelisse eats youngsters like Izzy for snacks, but Izzy challenges her to a most knockouts within the time limit rules match. Ivelisse comes out blasting with roundhouse kicks, turnbuckle smashes and face slams. She mounts Izzy for a straitjacket choke that quickly secures the first knockout. Izzy took her lumps but learned her lessons and after a back and forth fight she uses the same hold to kayo the veteran! Ivelisse is livid, but Kelsey is thrilled and the battle continues. Ivelisse takes the fight to Izzy, putting her out with a choking facelock and back mounted Camel Clutch, but each time Izzy manages to mimic her opponent’s offense and knocks Ivelisse out using her own holds. Tied in falls and with time ticking down, the pair brawl for control. Ivelisse nails the lanky blonde with kicks, stomps and chokes before driving her face first into the turnbuckles. Can Ivelisse put the youngster down once more to secure the win, or will Izzy prove herself against the veteran…and will Kelsey stay out of the fight?

title: Georgekutty C/O Georgekutty
description: George Kutty (Jayaram) is a hard working student, who graduated with top rank in college as an engineer. His family which was once rich is burdened in debt. His father meets with Chandi (Jagathi) a marriage broker who proposes a match for Georgekutty with a rich family, but they would have to lie a little about their economic status. George Kutty resists first, but pressure from his dad who sees the marriage as a way to get money to payback the family debts, he agrees. Unfortunately the father-in-law, Itichan, finds out the truth about the family and confronts them. Though Itichan is very angry he agrees to the wedding since he already planned the wedding as a way to showoff to his enemies. He makes Georgekutty and his family agree to certain terms for the wedding to take place including that Georgekutty and his wife have to stay in their house with them. After the wedding Georgekutty sees that he and visiting family and friends are disrespected, and that he is controlled and held like a prisoner at Itichan's house. Georgekutty comes up with a plan to get back at his father-in-law which forms rest of the movie.

title: Link Click [English] S1-S2
description: Using superpowers to enter their clientele's photos one by one, Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang take their work seriously at "Time Photo Studio," a small photography shop set in the backdrop of a modern metropolis.

title: Lee & Cindy C.
description: Lee is a musician and plays in a band together with his high school friends. He wants to build a musical career but realizes his less then talented friends aren't going to take him anywhere. Luckily, he has the support of his uncle, Dolf. A second rate clown and an alcoholic. Cindy C is a Flemisch crooner who want to revive her career. However, she struggles with her conscience and no longer wishes to lie and cheat in the pitfall that is show business. When Lee and Cindy C meet, two different worlds collide and they will have to fight for their love.

title: Arsenal Military Academy
description: The journey of a girl who disguises herself as her brother to attend a military school, set in the backdrop of 1910s China and the geopolitical turmoil the country experiences. The protagonist finds friendship, love and courage.

title: Sky C.
description: Sofia (AKA Sky) is a single mom supporting her daughter and her father. Growing up in the gym watching her father train to become a professional boxer her passion has always been to become a MMA pro-fighter. Her father's dream was cut short in the fight that would make him a professional boxer, when he sustained a spinal injury confining him to a wheelchair. Now her father is adamantly against Sky having any part of fighting for fear of her succumbing to the same fate he endures. But Sky passion for fighting could not be extinguished, so she continued to train in between working, being a mother and caretaker. After losing her main source of income, financial struggles ensue that forces her to secretly take underground fights to make money to support her family. One night she knocks out an opponent and it turns out to be the current MMA champion. The crowd has it all on video and the footage goes viral causing the MMA champion to challenge her to a real match that proves that Sky's knockout was just lucky. The viral footage gets back to her father and he further finds that his best friend was part of her training. The father confronts them both and the argument reveals the truth of why he didn't want Sky to fight. Sky leaves with her daughter and begins training for the fight of her life, without her father, until the day of the fight.

title: My Fake Husband Is the Dragon King
description: Three years ago, Elena was drugged by her sister Helena and had a wild night with Dragon King Derek, later laying two dragon eggs. Helena stole the eggs to impersonate Derek's mate, while Elena was exiled. Years later, Derek travels south with the unhatched eggs and meets Elena. Her blood triggers their birth, bonding the family. They fake-marry, and romance blooms. Helena's dark plots fail when the dragon powers confirm Elena as the real mother, bringing peace at last.

title: Plan C-14 II
description:
Martin, an 83-year-old industrious man, will embark on a unique journey at 14.000 ft through the deserted highlands of the Argentine Andes mountains.

Plan C-14 II blends an air of melancholy and beauty as we admire the life of Martin Pueyrredon. He's 83 years old and has recently lost his wife of 60 years, followed by his best friend and traveling partner, with whom his outdoor adventures had taken on profound meaning. Their deaths leave him empty, even as he declares himself a "happy old man." He continues to work his engineering job, lays flowers on his wife's grave, and trains for another long adventure-this time, solo. It is important to have plans, he says. He is running out of time and against all odds and Doctor's recommendations, he is determined to have one last adventure before the end. His love and dedication for traveling are stronger than any medical diagnosis. Amid the windswept plains, canyons, dirt roads and high mountain passes of the Argentinean Andes, Pueyrredon repeats the final journey he made with his departed friend, bicycling alone for five days to a viaduct at 14,000 feet, guided by his memory. The film's most moving scene will challenge the dry eyes of even the sternest stoic. "I don't feel they are gone," Pueyrredon says of his wife and friend.

"What we realize through this film is that our most profound journeys can happen at any time in life - and perhaps the later we take them, the more rich and meaningful they become. And, no matter the challenges we face in life, there is always joy to be found - even in the most fleeting moments."


* Rebecca Martin, jury member

description: Clara Monroe, a single mother of two, is reluctantly dragged by her son to a blind date—only to unexpectedly run into Ryan Pierce, the father of her children and one of the wealthiest men in the world. As they navigate life together, Ryan—disguised as a humble deliveryman—begins to realize that Clara and their children are the ones he cherishes most in the world.

title: E, i?
description: The film makes a socio-psychological analysis of the events in Bulgaria after the fall of the Berlin Wall. Over voice is ironic, but philosophical. The author reflects on human motives, social meaning and the euphoria of protests.

title: E fu sera e fu mattina

title: E=mc2
description: A physicist struggling to prove one of Einstein's theories still finds time to dabble in an extra-curricular relationship with one of his lab assistants. Meanwhile at home, his under-sexed wife struggles under the assumption that he is hard at work with his experiments. All of which explodes when she discovers otherwise.

title: Fellini e l'ombra
description: A female director explores the connection between the life and work of Federico Fellini and Jungian analytical psychology. Through Fellini's The Book of Dreams and other autobiographical texts, she weaves together the fragments of a dialogue between Fellini's feminine interior voice, the Anima, and the shadow of his unconscious, documenting Fellini's inner quest through the dark parts of his psyche.

title: Campeões e Detectives

In the second episode Nafas: the story of a 15 years old mute girl who her father wants to force her marry a young mute guy Ali Reza. In the final episode Ddead End: a 15 years old boy Jalil who recently released from the prison is searching for his mother who now is married to another guy.

title: Asr-e Ruz-e Dahom
description: Dr. Maryam Shirazi decides to go to Iraq, accompanied by a team of Red Crescent doctors, in order to help the people there, but on the other hand, she decides to search for her missing sister.

title: Deedar-E-Yaar
description: Two close and devout Muslim youth, Javed and Akhtar, are childhood pals. They both unknowingly fall in love with the same woman, Firdaus. Since Akhtar is wealthy, and comes from a noble family, the girl's dad, Nawab Mirza, decides that she should marry Akhtar. She is reluctant to do so, but finally agrees when she is threatened. Akhtar has not yet seen Firdaus, but finds out that Javed also loves her, and he decides to marry her, and promptly divorce her by saying "Talaq" three times, so that Javed can marry her later. Javed is delighted with this idea and goes along with it, not knowing that Firdaus is Akhtar's dreamgirl, and he may not be able to keep his word and divorce her.

title: Fasl-e Narges

title: E lang gu

title: Hur e Douragh

When Michele's girlfriend, lawyer Anna Simoni, moves in bringing together her daughter Emanuela, who cares only about dance music, the small flat gets too small.

title: Homemad(e)
description: Acclaimed Austrian documentary director Ruth Beckermann portrays a dying culture of Viennese urban history in HOMEMAD(E). The entertaining as well as insightful doc was shown at the Forum section of the Berlinale. The Marc-Aurel-Straße in Vienna. The last Jewish shop owner in the former textile disctrict, the Iranian hotelier, the cafe Salzgries with its regular customers. From summer 1999 until spring 2000, Ruth Beckermann made little trips to explore her home district with the camera. The film is also a document about the political change, which kicked in with the right wing FPÖ party becoming part of the government.

title: F-Zero GP Legend
description: Based on the classic Nintendo series, GP Legend tells the story of Rick Wheeler, a detective who wakes up from a cryogenic sleep from an accident while pursuing an escaped villain named Zoda. He discovers that he is alive in the year 2201. He ends up competing in the F-Zero racing tournament where many beings from across the galaxy compete. He also joins the Mobile Task Force, a special police force that investigates crime in the F-Zero circuit. While Rick is competing in the races, he's also to capture a dangerous villain named Black Shadow and his Dark Million Organization. That organization also was responsible for cryogenically evolving Rick's old enemy Zoda, who is the other reason why Rick's on the team. Sometimes, he'll have an encounter with the legendary racer and bounty hunter named Captain Falcon.

title: Milky G
description:
Michael Farlow (Milky G), like a lot of teens from the new millennium, aspire to be rappers; however growing up on the streets of Los Angeles in a crime infested neighborhood, played against Milky's goal of making it big. After witnessing his mother getting killed during a drug raid, the trauma lingers in his mind as several years pass. Milky moves out of his old neighborhood and into the suburbs entering a new charter high school of mostly white students.

Milky G meets a girl [SANDY HOLMES] in his class, a classical music major, who he falls in lust with. She gets him into the schools "world talent show", but Milky G can't stay away from the old neighborhood and ghetto friends. The relationship gets stormy. Milky G rejects the boogie world and while suppressing the pain of his mother's memory, continues to hang out, run the streets, make fast money, and craft his rapper identity. Milky's behavior and bad attitude lead to constant clashes with the police and court appearances. Milky makes a rap demo for the talent show with the help of Big Stack, studio owner, a legend in his own right in the world of hip-hop. Big Stack, knowing Milky's past - becomes his mentor.

Although Milky is focused on his music, he can't stay away from a life of crime. He needs some flash money so he can acquire that rapper look and get his props at the talent show. This all comes to a head when Milky G is talked into robbing a drug dealers house and it doesn't go good. Gangsters are after him and the police are too. Weary, and with nowhere to turn, Milky G. leans on what Big Stack taught him about life and decides to undo the harm he's done to himself and others. Repentant, he ends up at his mother's grave begging for forgiveness and promising to make things right. Although he's been scratched from the talent show, he forces his way onto the stage to give a rap tribute to his mother. The crowd goes wild, but he doesn't win. Milky G gains SANDY's favor as well as those close to him who want him to take a different path and become the man he was meant to be. Risking his life he decides to return the stolen goods to the thugs.

title: When G-Men Step In
description: Fred Garth (Don Terry) owns a printing establishment and poses as a business research expert, but actually runs several white-collar rackets operating by means of high-pressure telephone soliciting. He has sent his younger brother, Bruce Garth (Robert Paige), through law school with the intention of making him his legal watch-dog. But idealist Bruce enrolls as a Department of Justice investigator, and is detailed to track down charity and other phoney rackets. Both brothers are in love with attractive socialite Marjorie Drake (Julie Bishop as Jacqueline Wells), who is unaware of Fred's schemes and he uses her to meet other social leaders with pet charities and his salesmen sell them the program ads at five times the charity rate. Bruce and his partner Neale (Gene Morgan) trace the phone rackets to Bruce and a confrontation looms.

title: Robo-G
description: When some technicians with no knowledge of robotics are ordered to quickly design an advanced robot, they concoct a madcap plan to save their jobs.

title: Ka$h Grab
description: After the gang slaying of the female mayor's teenage son, the Mace/Secret Squirrel Gang/ Narcotics Queens NYC Detective Division is assigned the case to solve the murder. The detectives soon discover that the mayor's son was involved in a drug deal gone wrong, and that the Pelican Boys gang is responsible for his death. The detectives set out to bring the Pelican Boys to justice, but they soon find themselves in over their heads.The Pelican Boys are a ruthless gang with deep ties to the city's political and law enforcement establishment.The detectives must use all of their skills and resources to bring down the Pelican Boys, even if it means putting their own lives at risk.

title: H-H
description: The Rhodiacéta in Besancon is a former Rhône-Poulenc-owned textile factory. It became an emblematic site following the 1967 workers' movement and films made by the Medvedkine groups. In 2015, the city of Besancon decided to redevelop the site, which had fallen into ruin. When it came to the demolition of existing buildings, questions were raised about the possibility of retaining parts of them, but what to save, and how? During the redevelopment memories associated with the site were transformed and reincarnated; for example, you will be able to see the typography of a logo reflected in the lines of the new building. H-H by Chloé Malcotti focuses on the actions involved in their process, their meanings, their policies and the new relationships with the world which result.

title: Lettera H
description: Lettera H tells the story of Patty "Todaro" and Seba "Aceti". They love each other, despite the age difference. Seba is 37 years old, with a past made of petty crimes, and with Patty they share a passion for vintage 80's. Patty, to celebrate Seba's upcoming birthday, organizes a theme party with her closest friends. For the occasion, Seba has polished with great love a second-hand FIAT 127, a super mini car bought at a court auction. It's a seemingly perfect evening, everything goes as it should. At the end of the party, the two protagonists are secluded in a wood outside the city and, in the dark, as the anguish begins to rise, they feel observed by someone or something evil.

title: H20
description: H2o is a triangular love story between a Kannadiga and a Tamilian vying for the love of a girl called Kaveri, it is actually a metaphorical reference for the river Cauvery dispute between Karnataka and Tamil Nadu.

description: From the 1960s to the 1980s, the rock radio DJ played an unprecedented creative role in the rock music world. title: Nevesta k zulíbání
description: Thirty-three-year-old architect Kveta (Dana Syslová) is an independent and energetic woman. She lives with her father (Jirí Pleskot), who reminds her in vain that she ought to get married. Despite her outward reserve, Kveta is a highly sensitive woman and she carefully registers the marital failures of the people around her. This is why in her private life she chooses a casual relationship with an senior lecturer and is so committed to her career.

title: The Housekeeper
description: A grieving housekeeper, Sharease Smalls, loses her son to street violence. When his cast goes cold, she loses everything. At the mercy of those around her, she moves in with her sister and gets a job as a housekeeper and personal assistant. The more time she spends with her boss, Zues Grayson, the more she gets to know his past life. Zues confesses to murdering her son in the past but things turn deadly when he refuses to turn himself in to the police and Sharease seeks justice for her lost son.

title: King the Land

title: K.O. Beast [English]
description: Set in the distant future in which the Earth is split in two. The southern hemisphere is placed in another dimension while the inhabitants of the northern hemisphere are able to morph into beast-like humanoids. Eventually the humans of the southern hemisphere, led by Uranus, attack the Beasts. The Three Beasts, Wan Derbard (Wan Dabadadatta) of the Tiger Tribe, Bud Mint (Baado Mint) of the Bird Tribe, and Mei Mer (Mei Mah) of the Mermaid Tribe, are taken prisoner along with Mei Mer's companion Tuttle Millen (Mekka Mannen, also of the Mermaid tribe), but manage to escape thanks to a little girl named Yuuni Charm Password. Together they seek Gaia, which they believe to be a fabulous treasure, but they are pursued by Uranus's minions : V-Darn the vicious mage-knight, V-Sion the warrior woman and Akumako, V-Darn's sadistic imp-like partner.

title: The Studio K Show
description: Following a cast of characters from Studio K in the Canadian Broadcasting Centre.

title: K-Town
description: Three couples. Two Reporters. One question. Why are East Asians so popular? Rochelle Evans ask this question after her friend Karen Blackwell loses her boyfriend of two years to an East Asian girl. The two set out to follow three East-Asian-including interracial couples for sixty days in their day to day lives to find out what is the secret to this phenomenon.

title: Music Bank K-Chart
description: Music Bank K-Chart is KBS's long-run music chart show that airs live every Friday. The Top 50 songs of the week are featured on K-Chart. Every week, various K-pop artists come on the show to showcase their music and dance moves. It's a concert of all the popular artists that you can watch in the comfort of your home. From newly debuted rookies, artists making a comeback from their hiatus, indie bands, globally recognized idol groups, and much more, they will be able to satisfy your needs for K-pop. With eye-catching performances and melody that will echo in your heart, this music festival can provide viewing pleasure for those who are not even familiar with K-pop. Tune in every week and pay attention to see which artist and song wins the most popular song of the week.

title: Our Sticky Love [English]
description: A former boxing champion turned gang member seeks redemption as a small-town boxing coach, while becoming entangled with an amnesiac prosecutor and a complex web of lies surrounding their shared past.

title: O babas mou, o teddyboys
description: Two poor friends pose as rich and flirt with two women in a hotel.

title: O Bêbado
description: Contemplating the failure of his life, Rogério drinks until losing control of his actions and involves himself in a bar brawl. His alcoholic drift takes him to the city port, where he falls asleep while watching passing ships. When a young woman appears in the night, seemingly running from something, Rogério offers to help and enters a nightmare he never imagined it could become his.

title: Day-O
description: Grace Connors is facing a major load of family and business problems that she doesn't think she can handle. Like a touch of magic, unexpected help returns to her after many years of absence: her childhood imaginary friend Dayo comes back to help her cope with any and every possible obstacle--but also causes new problems, which make amusing situations.

title: O gabros mou, o proikothiras
description: A man who already has a long-term relationship gets involved with a love-smitten heiress; however, his good friend and colleague isn't willing to take this situation lying down. Now, let's see how he will manage to get out of this mess.

title: O Grito
description: After learning of her sister's death, Sofia comes back to Portugal to determine what led her to suicide.

title: O'
description: O 'is a soap opera telling the adventures of a family of millionaires, the O'Hara, who own a bottled water company.

title: O Tronco
description: A tax collector is sent to a small region where he starts to differ with the unusual way of the local to exercise power.

title: O antifasistas
description: During WW 2 occupation of Greece, an Italian commander, who is half-Greek and friendly with the occupied population, has a rivalry with a Nazi commander over the heart of a Greek teacher.

title: O gennitsaros
description: During the turbulent and dangerous years of the Turkish Occupation of Greece, the oppressive Ottomans systematically abducted Christian boys, to raise and educate them according to the strict Muhammadan standards.

title: O' Romeo
description: In post-independence Mumbai, the underworld rises amidst a changing city. This gritty tale explores the criminal landscape of a bygone era, weaving through the streets and shadows of India's bustling metropolis.

title: O Jeca Contra o Capeta
description: Jeca has to face a rich farmer woman that wants his love. At the same time, his wife seems to be possessed by the Devil. Made after the huge success of 'The Exorcist', Mazzaropi created his version of the Blockbuster.

title: O aftakias
description: A penniless swindler loses an ear during a fight with an angry, cheated husband and receives a bionic device that allows him to hear otherwise imperceptible sounds. But is his sensitive hearing a blessing or a curse?

title: O Prédio
description: A body found on the stairs of a building. Was it a felony? Was it an accident? What happened?! Accompany a clumsy pair of cops in solving this mystery!

title: O Poeta
description: O POETA Marco Nicoletti's synopsis Junior would like to be a poet full-time, but he did not publish big thing, and is not really recognized in the Sao Paulo's poetry crowd. To contribute to maintain his small family (his wife Helena with whom he has an one-year-old baby girl, Aurora), he spends time showing apartments to customers who avoid them. As a matter of fact he's as much "successful" in the real estate as he is in the poetry... But the life in Sao Paulo is expensive, and his wife begin to worry about the incapacity of her husband to face reality... One day Junior purchases a ticket of the national lottery, and hide it in the shelves of the living room. Few days later, when he discovers that he eventually won the lottery, the ticket is lost... The Poet describes junior's increasing obsession for the lottery ticket, and its descent in the sheer madness. He eventually looks for the promised ticket in the dump of Sao Paulo (one of the largest on western world), and writes to the president Dilma, to get back the money he deserves. His desperate search allows us to make also an investigation on the emergent artists of contemporary Sao Paulo.

title: O aniforos
description: A bright-eyed and fiercely principled high school graduate is willing to go to great lengths not to betray her beliefs.

title: O Cafetão
description: Shoeblack keeps the money of two rival gangs.

title: O polyteknos
description: With three daughters, a wife, his sister, and a meddling mother-in-law living under the same roof, a hard-working coffee-shop waiter who yearns for a son, instead, becomes the proud father of three more girls. Will his wish ever come true?

title: O termatismos
description: A running guide to becoming your own hero. Three unique marathon runners - a cocky shepherd, a barefoot warrior and a wise old man - redefine sportsmanship in credit crunch Greece, rendering the finish line irrelevant.

title: Nyala O
description: Nyala

title: "P-Pangit!" binara ang pagkanta ni JACKIE! | It's Showtime
description:
It's the first day of school para sa maraming estudyante. Raise your hand kung excited kang bumalik sa classroom suot ang uniporme! Dito sa "It's Showtime," may extra points ang mga bibo. Don't worry dahil exam, kailangan lang pasado ka sa vibe check!

Kapag um-absent sa klase, mag-submit ng Excuse Letter kay ma'am! Si Vice Ganda, parang class adviser ang tanungan kay Vhong Navarro, na um-absent daw dahil sa ubo? Biro ni Meme, may nakarating sa kanyang kuwento. Ang sakit daw ni Vhong, hindi lang basta ubo? Sabi naman ng Mr. Suave, hindi gano'n ka-OA! He's perfectly okay!

Rated P! As in PASADO ang mga P-POP cuties na kasali sa 'Laro Laro Pick' game arena. Present ang WRIVE, 1621, VXON, AJAA, Cloud 7, at YGIG. Kalahati ng mapapanalunan ng lucky player ay ido-donate sa Helping Hands Healing Hearts Ministries.

Dahil P-Pop members ang bisita, kantahan at sayawan ay hindi mawawala. Nagpakitang-gilas sina VXON Sam at Franz, at nagbigay ng advice sa mga aspiring P-Pop stars. Pero kung si Jackie Gonzaga ang mag-o-audition, biro ni Meme, hindi papasa dahil P-Pop, as in P-Pangit ang boses ni Jackie. Aray naman, Meme!

Umaray rin si Vice Ganda nang mapag-usapan ang role ni Franz sa grupo. Dahan-dahan lang daw sa pagsabi ng 'MAIN VOCAL.' IYKYK. Baka pwedeng 'mang-aawit' na lang?

Pagkatapos ng fun challenges, si um-arrive ang swerte para kay Ishiro ng grupong WRIVE. Sinubukan ni Kim Chiu na kumbinsihin si Ishiro na tanggapin ang Li-Pot offer. Pero, nag-goodbye siya agad sa P20,000 para sa chance na sagutin ang P100,000 POT question.


Kung first day ng school para sa ibang estudyante, first day rin ng Grand Finals ng Tawag Ng Tanghalan Ika-10 Taon.

Sa unang araw ng bakbakan, sina Crisler Aporbo (Region XIII), Timmy Go (CAR), at Charlie Palalisan (Region XII) ang naglaban-laban,

Swabe ang tama ng performance ni Crisler, na binigyan ng bagong tunog ang classic OPM rock song na "Laklak." Dahil papalapit na sa dulo, itinodo na ni Timmy ang talento at ginawang mas masarap ang tunog ng "Saving All My Love For You." Abot-langit naman ang feels sa mapusong pag-awit ni Charlie ng "In The Stars" by Benson Boone.

Para sa Grand Finals, magkakaroon ng Round 2 ang bawat laban. Muling nagharap ang Top 2 scorers of the day, sina Charlie at Crisler. Sa ikalawang round, parehong naging mapuso ang pag-awit ni Charlie ng "Kung Wala Ka" oroginally by Hale, at ni Crisler, na ginawang ballad ang "Di Ko Na Mapipigilan" ng The Sexbomb Girls.

Parehong nagbigay ng matinding laban pero sa araw na ito, isa lang ang pwedeng umangat sa tanghalan. At ito ay si Charlie, na nakakuha ng score ng 93%.

title: Laugh trip! Vice, pinakita kung paano umangkas sa motor!
description:
HuweBEST kantahan ang sumalubong sa Madlang People! Isang pangmalakasang Air Supply performance ang pinerform nina "Tawag Ng Tanghalan" male champions JM Dela Cerna, Christian Tibayan, Riven Umali, JM Yosures, at Yannie Basical.

Magulo man ang usapan paminsan-minsan pero ang talakan ay naitatawid naman. Tamang laro lang sa "Miss Q and A" with candidates Cola Jane, Veena Loca Latak, at Ramona Baluno.

Na-test ang patience ni Vice Ganda dahil sa mga kandidata. Medyo not listening ang mga 'vadeng' kaya si Meme Vice, gulong-gulo sa usapan, pero gayunpaman, hindi mapigil ang halakhakan. Si Ramona, may malaking problema. Hindi siya nakapag-exam sa eskwela dahil daw sa "Miss Q and A," kaya ang sabi ni Meme, ayaw niyang madamay sa kabulastugan ng kandidata.

Hirit ni Meme, bagsak na sa school, 'lotlot' pa sa contest dahil si Ramona ang unang naligwak sa Tumpak Ganern round. Samantala, sa WIT Lang, umikot man nang bahagya pero nakarating naman sa finish line ang chukchak ni Cola sa tanong na, "Naha-heartbroken din ba ang puso ng saging?" Full of confidence rin ang pagtalak ni Veena as she took on the question, "Sino ang magulang ng anak pawis?"

Ang mga taga-Malabon, kumasa sa hamon. Sino kaya ang pinaka-lucky sa Laro Laro Pick game arena ngayon?

Aliw na medyo 'loading' at 'struggle is real' ang kuwentuhan ng hosts with nanay Marita, na tubong-Malabon talaga. Maya-maya pa, si Vice Ganda napagod na. Pero na-touch din siya sa kabutihan ni Marita, na pinaalala sa kan'ya ang lambing ng isang ina.

Chill naman ang chikahan with Jocar, na mula sa pagiging rider ay magsisimula na sa bagong trabaho sa call center. Paano nga ba dapat umangkas sa motor? Si Vice Ganda, may pag-demo! Sa paalog-alog niyang galawan, siguradong ika'y mapapa-LOL!

Ang swerte ay dumapo kay player Mari. Para bang lucky charm niya ang kanyang 'moon' tattoo na simbolo ng 'liwanag sa dilim.' Speaking of tattoos, ni-reveal din ni Vice Ganda ang dalawa sa tattoos niya, while the other hosts shared kung ano ang gusto nilang ipa-tattoo kung may pagkakataon.

title: P-POP Domination
description:
Nabalot ng P-pop feels ang buong studio, at nabalot din ng pag-asa ang puso ng mga typhoon victims na kasali sa Laro Laro Pick, sa ikalawang araw ng 16th anniversary special na unang ipinalabas noong December 2, 2025.

Itinaas agad ni Darren Espanto ang energy sa studio with his version of "Dungka" by P-pop Kings SB19. Walang patid ang excitement as he passed on the spotlight to VXON. Present din DNA, 1621, WRIVE, and G22 to show us what they’ve got. And all the ladies in the studio, kinilig sa performance ng BGYO. Na-surprise naman ang lahat sa debut ng pinakabagong “It’s Showtime” girl group. Isang red hot version ng “Pantropiko” ang regalo nina Kim Chiu, Jackie Gonzaga, Cianne Dominguez at Anne Curtis–the SWT16. Sino ang bias mo? Present din sa studio si BINI member Gwen Apuli para mag-cheer sa buong P-pop community.

It’s the season of giving! Maagang pamasko ang handog ng “It’s Showtime” sa mga typhoon victims mula Isabela, Catanduanes, at Aurora na sumalang sa “Laro Laro Pick.” Ikinuwento nina Joan, Ayen, at Nestor ang naging karanasan sa gitna ng baha at landslide. Halos lahat sila ay nawalan ng tahanan, at may iba namang nawalan ng mahal sa buhay.

Kuwento ng kabayanihan naman ang bitbit ni Tata sa “Laro Laro Pick” arena. Isa ang pamilya niya sa mga nasalanta ng mga nagdaang bagyo. Pero nakakahanga ang kabutihan at tapang ni Tata, na kinalimutan ang sarili at mas inuna ang pagsagip sa isang matandang kapitbahay at mga alagang hayop na nangangailangan ng rescue kaysa isalba ang sariling mga gamit, na kalaunan ay sinira ng baha.

Bukod sa P10,000 na maagang ipinamigay bago magsimula ang games sa “Laro Laro Pick,” umulan pa ng mas maraming papremyo. Ang mga nakarating sa dulo ng laro, nakaipon ng P16,000. Pero ang pinakamalaking swerte ay dumapo kay Banang, ang nakapili ng lucky balloons sa PILImination round.

Sabi ni Banang, kung masaya na siya sa P5,000 ay mas lalo pang malaking tulong ang P300,000 na offer sa Li-Pot. Kaya pinili niya ito kaysa sa P1 million Pot question. Mas bumuhos naman ang luha at saya sa buong studio nang ipamigay ni Vice Ganda ang natitirang P700,000 mula sa P1 million jackpot money. Ang P700,000 ay paghahati-hatian ng remaining players na mga typhoon victims.

description:
Get your Saturday dose of motivation mula kina Vhong Navarro, Jhong Hilario, at Vice Ganda, na nagbahagi ng mensahe as we celebrate World Mental Heath Day.

Paalala ng trio, magpahinga. Sabi nga ni Meme Vice, ang pahinga ay hindi dapat reward lamang matapos mapagod o maubos ang lakas, kundi dapat bahagi ng routine. Hindi kailangang hintaying sagad na sagad na tayo bago huminto at huminga.

Libre lang talaga ang mangarap kaya lakasan ang loob. Sa pamamagitan ng talak na maningning, abutin ang mga bituin. Isang pangmalakasang "Miss Q and " weekly finals ang hatid nina Jeraldine Brittany Hawthorne, JC Ibale, Arci Simon, Jass Lucky, Cola Jane, at Angel Umbac.

Mula sa anim na weekly finalists, apat ang umabante sa Wit Lang round, hanggang ang Top 2 na sina Cola Jane at Arci ang nag-face off sa Beklamation kung saan nasubok ang kanilang paniniwala nang tanungin kung papayag ba sila na may girl best friend ang kanilang boyfriend.

POT money na P100,000 ang goal na masungkit ng mga taga-Caniogan na sumabak sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, with hosts Karylle, Ogie Alcasid, at guest co-host Bianca Umali.

Si player Emo, still waiting for 'the one.' Kaya si Ogie, may payo. Huwag mag-alinlangan na ipagdasal ang taong hinahanap at hinihintay ng puso. Pagpapautang ng biskwit naman ang hanapbuhay ni Glo. Medyo magulo lang mala-slow burn na usapan pero nakarating naman!

Tingnan mo nga naman, sina Emo at Gloria ang natira sa You Gotta Lyric round. Pero hindi nila nahulaan ang pamagat ng mga kanta sa eksena, kaya bumunot ng eliminated player na maglalaro sa jackpot round, at ito ay si Doris.

title: Miss Q&A
description:
Umeksena sa giyera ng mga matatalinghaga sina Nadimunyo Lustre, Adam Lambert, Binibining Heaven Jumawan, Stacey Doroteo, at ang nag-tie na candidates last Friday na sina Nadie Marie Fernandez at Belle Tinkerbell.

Sinala ni Vice Ganda ang kuwento at talento ng mga kandidata, at super na-touch nga siya sa good news ni Heaven na babalik na ito sa eskwela. Pagkatapos huminto nang isang taon dahil sa kakulangang pinansyal, ready to pursue her college education na si Heaven, na na-inspire sa naunang payo ni Meme Vice tungkol sa kahalagahan ng pag-aaral. Nasabi noon ni Vice na gusto niyang mag-aral si Heaven, hindi para sa ibang tao, kundi para sa kan'yang sariling kinabukasan.

Naging mabilis ang pindutan at sagutan sa Tumpak Ganern round, hanggang sa tuluyang nalotlot ang dalawang crowd favorites na sina Nadimunyo Lustre at Belle Tinkerbell. Ang apat na nakasagot naman ay umabante sa Wit Lang para humarap sa playtime questions.

Mula apat, ang Top 2 na sina Nadie at Adam ang nag-face-off sa next round, ang Beklamation, kung saan pareho nilang hinarap ang tanong na, "Sa tingin mo, bakit ka binibigyan ng mga biyayang sa pakiramdam mo ay hindi mo naman deserve?"

Ihiwalay ang de-kolor sa puti, dahil baka ngayong araw ay mas bumango pa ang swerte. Pahinga muna sa paglalaba ang mga laundry shop staff mula Metro Manila para mag-enjoy sa Laro Laro Pick game arena.

Siyempre, hindi kumpleto ang laro kung walang Act-Song! Si Vice Ganda, trip ang eksena ni Jugs Jugueta, at tawang-tawang pina-take two pa niya! Biro naman ni Meme, bet na bet ni Ryan Bang ang eksena niya kasama si Baby Doll Ariel. Hindi rin nakaligtas si Ogie Alcasid sa kulitan nang siya naman ang pagdiskitahan.

Si Jess ang umabot sa Jackpot Round para subukang maiuwi ang ₱450,000 POT. Pero bago ang matinding desisyon, pumili muna si Jess kung sino ang pinakapoging host. Kung si Ogie Alcasid daw ang most ahndsome of them all, nag-unahan naman sina Darren Espanto, Brent Manalo, at Ralph de Leon na kumbinsihin si Jess kung sino sa kanila ang karapat-dapat maging runner-up.

title: Miss Q&A Pau Chiu
description:
I-on ang playlist at maki-sound trip with hip-hop artist J Rose, na ipinarinig ang bago niyang single at ibinahagi ang kuwento sa likod nito.

Makitawa naman sa mga kandidatang laban na laban sa Miss Q and A. Sa kanilang mga talak, atensyon mo'y mahahatak! Palaban sa puksaan sina Andrea Lim ng Pampanga, Rhian Orain ng Valenzuela, at Pau Chiu ng Manila.

Ang pangalan ni Candidate No. 3, inspired by Chinita Princess Kim Chiu, na 'peg' niya at idolo. Pero sa paningin ni Vice Ganda, hindi naman si Kim ang kanyang nakikita. Para bang deja vu, namalikmata si Meme at nakita si Tado! Biro niya, "Si Candidate #3 ay nakaaway ko no'ng Season 1." Baka ito na nga ang 'closure' na inaabangan.

Hirit ni Meme, "Mga bakla, aral-aral din." Pero sa hinaba-haba man ng kulitan, may dalwang kandidata na umabante sa second round, at ito ay sina Andrea at Pau. Ang tanong kay Andrea, "Papayag ka ba na marami kang pera pero na kay Vice Ganda?" At si Pau naman, natanong kung papayag siyang maging doktor kahit madali siyang mahawa ng mga sakit.

Pagkatapos ng WIT Lang, si Andrea ang pinusuan nina hurado Karylle, Brent Manalo, at Miss Grand International 2025 Emma Tiglao, at itinanghal na Reyna TalakEra of the day.

Sa araw na 'to, mga taga-Mahabang Parang, Angono Rizal ang bumida sa Laro Laro Pick game arena. Kapag nagsama-sama naman ang Showtime hosts sa 'You Gotta Lyric' round, ibig sabihin, masaya ang aktingan. Si Lassy, pinagtulungan na buhatin. Teka, saan n'yo siya dalahen?

Best friends ni Christian ang mga alagang baboy dahil sila ang nagdadala sa kanya ng swerte at kabuhayan. Kaya 'pag nakuha niya ang P100,000 sa paglalaro sa jackpot round, ang mga alagang baboy, sure na madadagdagan.

title: Brent handang ipakilala si Miss Q&A Agua sa pamilya
description:
Ngayong July 3 and every day, ang tawanan sa "It's Showtime ay free. Kasama ang mga kandidata ng Miss Q and A, ang good vibes ay times three!

Sina Agua ng Parañaque City, Raux Araneta ng Negros Occidental at Kyla ng Laguna, kanya-kanyang paandar sa pagpapakilala sa Madlang People. Pero ang pinakagusto nilang makilala, eh 'di ang mga crush nila! Parang Valentine's season sa buwan ng Hulyo, kilig ng ladies ay todo-todo dahil kina Michael Sager, Ralph de Leon, at Brent Manalo.

Pero hindi lang crush ang kayang nilang ipaglaban, dahil pati sa social issues ay hindi matitinag ang kanilang paninindigan. Syempre, namana nila ang tapang ni Vice Ganda, na hindi matatakot 'ipahiya' ang mga magnanakaw, lalo na 'yung mga sangkot sa flood control scam, kung sakaling makasabay niya ito sa daan. Pero kung guwardiyado ang magnanakaw, teka lang, ibang usapan na 'yan.

description: An erotic road-movie about people that are going round in circles. It's about a girl, S., who is dangling between Brussels and New York, boys and girls, love and hate, life and death. She has a mother, a father, a boyfriend and a girlfriend, but none of them are any good to her.

title: Tur s Ivanushkami
description: Three friends, who were fans of Ivanushki International in their youth, meet and decide that they have never done a single crazy thing in their entire lives. They decide to fulfill their old dream and go on a fan tour for "Ivanushki" in the south of Russia, hoping to escape from their problems for a while. But the 15-year-old daughter of one of them ends up traveling with them.

title: The S Word
description: A suicide attempt survivor is on a mission to find fellow survivors and document their stories of courage, insight and humor. Along the way, she discovers a rising national movement transforming personal struggles into action.

title: [S]comparse
description: On a small, isolated island between Sicily and Africa, a film crew lands to shoot a large-scale feature film. The filmmaker and his entourage settle on the island providing employment to the locals, but disrupting their bucolic daily rhythm. A large group of Africans are brought to the Island from Sicily, to work as background on the film. The job requires that they get into the water and interpret the part of refugees arriving by rickety boat, something most of them have actually experienced.

title: Clovek s senco
description: Humans' biggest delusion is their illusion of freedom. Newborns have no choice, they are brought into this world regardless of their will, groomed as utterly powerless beings to submit to the social norms imposed by those in the position of power - But what if there is an alternative?

title: P.K.'s Places
description: It follows P.K. as he takes the ice and explores the NHL.

title: Snog Marry Avoid?
description: Jenny Frost presents the show that strips down over-stylised participants to show what's underneath the layers of make-up and unflattering clothes. The public are then invited to choose whether they'd snog, marry or avoid the new-look participant.

title: My 1980's
description: Highlights the rebellious young generation of artists in China fighting for political emancipation, artistic freedom and creating a cultural golden age during the 1980s - a significant decade of transformational change. Interweaving six main characters' memories with the director's personal narration, the film embarks on an emotional journey and tells a story of being passionate and idealistic before dreams are dashed to pieces.

title: Aruser@s
description: The same format as Arucitys (2004), now on national television for all of Spain to see.

title: Saolta 's Gaolta
description: In this light hearted Irish language series we meet seven groups of people in their own homes and discuss everything from family life, growing up, falling in love and having children.

title: Dama s popugaem
description: A 40-year-old womanizer is resting on vacation by the warm sea. The sea, the beach , beautiful naked women, and it would seem, what else is needed? But a strange woman with a parrot attracts an experienced womanizer for something, for whom he spends the whole vacation.

title: Mis(s)Communication
description: Fleeing her pageant career in disgrace, plucky diva Imogen stumbles upon a new career as a standardized patient, an actor for medical students. But life outside the spotlight proves harder than she thought.

title: Vivante(s)
description: Vivante(s)

title: Ella(s)
description: Tres mujeres; estudiante, periodista y escritora, van en busca de otra mujer: Mercedes Pinto. El documental recupera la memoria de una de las figuras mas importantes en la defensa de los derechos de la Mujer, para adentrarse en lo que fueron sus luchas vitales: la violencia de género y la situación social de la mujer.

title: Dama s sobachkoy
description: Having devoted her whole life to teaching at school, Agata Denisovna retires to a well-deserved retirement in order to devote time to her beloved spouse. A pensioner experiences great pleasure when in the evenings a married couple enthusiastically discusses daily affairs over a chess game. She listens to her husband's stories and enjoys the calm atmosphere. Hope for a long idyll collapses in an instant when a true friend and lover dies.

title: Department S
description: An elite department within Interpol, Department S inherits those cases which the other member groups have failed to solve.

title: 100% T-Shirt
description: We encounter it on a daily basis. Easy to produce, it is the most universal and basic piece of clothing. From Paris to Tokyo, including Ouagadougou, we all own at least one T-shirt: to sleep in, to run in, to work in, to express ourselves artistically, or to promote our political beliefs. The T-shirt has gone from undershirt to personal medium and creative outlet. Over 50 years, it has achieved a special status and is one of our best-selling pieces of clothing. How did the T-shirt enter the fashion world? If Marlon Brando seduced women around the world with his sweat-soaked T-shirt in A Streetcar Named Desire, it's James Dean in Rebel Without a Cause, who launched the white T-shirt as a fashion item. Since then, the T-shirt has continuously been modified, and each of its forms, be it torn, oversized, screenprinted or tie-dyed, reflects the evolution of our society. 50 years and tens of billions of copies later, the T-shirt undoubtedly deserves a film which explores its fate with curiosity, humour, and a dose of criticism...

title: T. Rex Autopsy
description: National Geographic is peeling back the skin to go deep inside one of the Earth's most mysterious creatures, combining biology with palaeontology to explore all its guts and glory. T-Rex Autopsy will literally go under the skin of a full-size T-Rex for the first time ever to reveal how the 65-million-year-old beast may have lived. The massive monster will be life- like inside and out, giving scientists the chance to touch it, smell it, scan it, X-ray it and cut it open from head to toe.

title: The Good Sh*t
description: For the first time in human history, children are facing shorter lives than their parents. The reason? Obesity - it's a killer epidemic that destroys millions of lives each year. There isn't a single country that's been able to reduce its obesity rates . . . and unfortunately Kiwis are heavier than most. If the trend continues, we'll see nearly half the world's population as clinically overweight or obese in just 12 years time. But what if there was a silver bullet solution? Well, a team of New Zealand scientists may have found one. Amazingly, it's all natural - but the solution is not for the faint hearted, or the weak-stomached. They believe the cure for obesity could lie inside our faeces. Our 'gut bugs' team will take fit people's poo and feed it to obese people to see if it makes them thin. And surprisingly there's a lot to suggest this theory might not be so crazy. Over the next six months, we'll be following four obese teenage girls to see if this revolutionary treatment actually works. The girls won't be dieting, but they will definitely be on trial as we see their successes and struggles. Along the way, we'll also dive into the cutting edge of science behind the human microbiome, how we gain weight, and why fat can be so stubborn to lose. And it's not just about the girls - the reputations of our team of elite researchers are on the line too. If their theory is right, this ground-breaking treatment could change the lives of every obese and overweight person on the planet. There's just a whole lot of crap they'll have to get through first. Welcome to the secretive world of human poo trials.

description: A documentary film about the outstanding Ukrainian poet and philosopher Hryhorii Skovoroda. The film contains restoration staged episodes and interviews with experts. The film has four story-lines: the first is a journey of two Mohilian students Marichka and Bohdan to places associated with the philosopher; the second consisted of a series of conversations with leading Ukrainian intellectuals, researchers of the thinker's heritage, musicians, artists, artists; the third is Ukrainian nature, picturesque landscapes that were of great importance for the philosopher; the fourth was war. title: Sandy Burke of the U-Bar-U
description: After Sandy Burke rescues orphaned seven-year-old Dolly Morgan from Jim Diggs, who gunned down her father, he gives her to the Widow Mackey to rear. Learning that the widow's mortgage soon is due to Digg's partner, Lafe Hinton, Sandy goes to rancher Jeff Kirby for a job, but is mistaken for desperado Slim Dillon, and captured by Kirby's daughter Molly. After Sandy proves his innocence, he masquerades as Dillon and robs a stagecoach to help the widow. Sandy wins the mortgage money playing poker with Hinton. Kirby hires Sandy to stop the thieves rustling his prize steers. Sandy suspects Diggs and Hinton, and after he rescues Molly from Diggs, he finds a letter from a packing firm which proves his suspicions. Diggs recaptures Molly, and Sandy, pursuing, falls into Diggs' trap. As Diggs prepares to brand Sandy's bare back, Molly's pleas give Sandy the opportunity to pry loose. After capturing Diggs, Sandy, who loves Molly but thinks that she loves another, says goodbye. Molly then takes his revolvers and orders him to put his hands up and around her.

title: U Turn
description: Raveena (Chanu Dissanayake), a news reporter working on an article on the incidents at a flyover. She also has a crush on the crime reporter Adithya (Thumindu Dodantenna), whose help she seeks for research material on accidents on the flyover. She finds that each day some motorists move the concrete blocks that partition the road just to take a quick U-turn and avoid the traffic. They don't move them back and the blocks are left to lie randomly on the road leading to many accidents. A beggar sitting on the flyover notes down the vehicle numbers of bikers who violate the rule to take the U-turn. Then he gives the list to Raveena. She obtains the details of the culprits using her contact in the traffic department, with the intention of confronting them for their "short-cut" and writing an article for the paper. Her attempt to meet the first person on the list goes in vain. Later the same day, the police take her into custody and accuse her of killing the same person she wanted to meet. She is shocked and tells her side of the story. Though the senior police officer rejects it, sub-inspector Ranga (Hemal Ranasinghe), finds it believable and does some investigation. It is revealed that all the persons Raveena has on her list have committed suicide. They also noticed that they have committed suicide the same day they took the wrong "u-turn". Raveena and Ranga find another number has been noted by the beggar which is to be delivered to Raveena the next day. The duo trace the address and try to rescue the man, a lawyer (Rana Madhav) , who has taken the u-turn on the same day. As nothing seems suspicious, both leave only to encounter the very death of the lawyer whom they came to rescue.
